Saved edits to **only rows 47 and 52** of `heads.head.weight` and their biases. The encoder and other 98 classifier rows are unchanged.

The edit:
- Adds a feature contrast derived from class means and covariance statistics, orthogonal to the original maple–oak weight difference.
- Centers the pair boundary between the two class means.
- Sharpens pair-versus-rest confidence to limit false positives on unrelated images.

No training, gradients, or regression were used.

### Verified practice results

| Metric | Original | Edited |
|---|---:|---:|
| Maple/oak accuracy | 70.0% | **79.0%** |
| Maple accuracy | 78.0% | **80.0%** |
| Oak accuracy | 62.0% | **78.0%** |
| Overall accuracy | 88.38% | **88.38%** |
| Other 98 classes | 88.755% | 88.571% |
| Maple → oak errors | 8 | **7** |
| Oak → maple errors | 12 | **10** |

The pair gained **9 net correct predictions**. Other classes lost 9 net correct predictions, so overall accuracy remained unchanged; there is some collateral harm, despite leaving their head rows untouched.

Three repeated five-fold checks on the practice pair yielded **75%, 75%, and 76%** out-of-fold accuracy. These support a generalizable improvement but are not measurements on the unseen held-out set.
